Index Terms.heading: **Index Terms**—Cloud computing, Energy efficiency, Quality of service, Task scheduling.

IV. Experimental Results.heading: Modern cloud datacenters require efficient task scheduling under fluctuating arrival rates and heterogeneous processor capabilities. In this work, we propose Adaptive-DynaSched, a load-aware scheduling framework that dynamically balances execution makespan, energy consumption, and deadline compliance. Through rigorous empirical evaluation across 10 evaluation seeds, we demonstrate that our proposed approach achieves a 45.01% latency reduction over Round-Robin while maintaining zero Service Level Agreement (SLA) violations.
